title: Internal reviews squeezed to the end
detect_signals: Only one internal review, the week before QA
Weeks of design and media work with no review
sim_effect: Hidden rework builds up unseen and surfaces once QA starts, when it is most expensive to fix.
accepted_fixes: Spread internal reviews through the build, at least every three or four weeks
Review each module as it is finished, plus a pass before QA
partial_fixes: Move the single review two weeks earlier
Add a longer review at the end
concept: Rework cycle: find defects early instead of inspecting at the end
sop_ref: LD SOP: milestone reviews; PM SOP: internal touchbases
explanation: Putting all review at the end means problems stay hidden until there is no time left to fix them. Regular reviews surface rework while it is cheap.
note: Planted on the three original projects; the plants name tasks the newer projects do not have.
